cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a riverside pavilion tower over the Yangtze — holds a gourd-shaped wine flask on a red cord by its cord at chest height; her tower bedchamber in a stone castle — lying on her front; a riverside seating area waiting for festival fireworks — standing; a chandelier ballroom at a masquerade — holds a cocktail glass by the stem at chest height; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — raises a small red paper lantern beside her face so its glow lights her cheek; a candlelit gala dinner hall — seated on a chair; a pilot ready room beside a hangar — shakes a gourd-shaped wine flask on a red cord by her ear to hear how much wine is left; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — standing; a penthouse window wall over the city at night — holds a cup in both hands; a starship galley and mess hall — holds a towel folded against her chest; her living room with a deep sofa — sips a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw through the straw; an open pavilion floating above a sea of clouds at sunrise — holds a book closed against her chest; a riverside pavilion tower over the Yangtze — carries a pipa lute by its neck at her side
